source_note: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则
english_source_note: Liouville Principles for Holomorphic and Meromorphic Functions
callout_id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#3
statement_en: Let \(f(z)\) be entire and satisfy $$\\int_{0}^{2\\pi} |f(re^{i \	heta})|\\, d\	heta < r^{1/2},\\quad \\forall r>0.$$ Prove that \(f\\equiv 0\).
callout_body:
整函数$f(z)$满足不等式,$$\int_{0}^{2\pi}
|f(re^{i \theta})| d\theta < r^{1/2},\forall r >0$$ 证明函数为0.
